## Description

Firely SDK client; read patient/encounter/meds into "Synced from HIS" copies; write back only clinician-signed content (DocumentReference, MedicationStatement…) with idempotency keys and receipts; queue states Delivered/Failed/Conflict/Retrying/Sent to clinician; conflict diff (Medvya signed v1 vs HIS current) routed to the signing clinician; transport errors retried by IT; chart shows "Not yet in HIS".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Medvya never overwrites the HIS silently; conflicts always go to the clinician (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Write-back success ≥ 99 % in the pilot with every failure/conflict visible (exit gate 2).
- [ ] **AC3.** Duplicate deliveries are prevented by idempotency keys.
- [ ] **AC4.** Attempts list shows timestamps and response codes without PHI in logs.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
